analysis.session_summary: Japanese verbal intervention drove the day: JPY closed strongest at +0.881%, USD/JPY fell 159.3 pips and closed near its lows. US Revised UoM beat forecast 48.1 vs 47.4 but gave only a brief USD bid, with DXY down 0.209% and USD lower at -0.129%. Risk assets were firm, SPX +0.262% and VIX -0.176%, while Brent dropped 2.017% on Iran-US technical-stage talks.

themes.evidence: JPY closed strongest at +0.881%; USD/JPY -159.3 pips and CHF/JPY -207.9 pips with multiple Katayama headlines.

themes.theme: US data beat failed to hold dollar bid
themes.evidence: Revised UoM actual 48.1 vs forecast 47.4 gave only +0.047% USD impulse; DXY closed -0.209%.
Iran-US technical-stage headline preceded EUR/USD late +1.5 pip leg and Brent -2.017%; VIX -0.176%.

currency_drivers.USD: UoM beat gave brief USD bid, but broad dollar sold off to -0.224% and closed weak.
currency_drivers.EUR: No euro-specific catalyst; ended flat after attempt to +0.095% was fully rejected.
currency_drivers.JPY: Japanese officials verbally intervened against weak yen; Trump/Katayama strong-yen headlines fueled rally.
currency_drivers.GBP: Bailey speech was muted; GBP faded a +0.06% bid with no directional catalyst.
currency_drivers.AUD: No Australian catalyst; early selling to -0.214% was 75% recovered.
currency_drivers.CAD: No Canadian catalyst; early +0.07% bid faded, CAD weakest among majors.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss catalyst; early +0.08% attempt rejected and CHF closed lower.
currency_drivers.NZD: No New Zealand catalyst; NZD held near lows after early dip to -0.264%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped in a 51.2-pip range without a dominant catalyst, closing +13.8 pips as dollar weakness and late Iran headlines offset early flow.

polarity_reads.read: Normal: USD strengthened only 0.047% on the beat, suggesting limited long-dollar follow-through after data.
Muted: -0.011% USD impulse shows markets ignored the speech, with no fresh dollar premium priced.
Muted: GBP basket moved -0.014% inside noise, signaling Bailey gave no policy signal and positioning was flat.
